titleStmt.title: List of Abbreviations, Symbols, and Code Names

div.head: List of Abbreviations, Symbols, and Code Names
div.p: Editor’s Note.—This list does not include standard abbreviations in common usage or unusual abbreviations of rare occurrence which are clarified in footnotes to the text.
